tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// gu ru drag dmar gyi bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge nyung ngu don 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgyal ba kun dngos pad+ma 'byung*// dregs pa gdul phyir zlos pa'i gar// pad+ma thod phreng rtsal btud de// de yi bsnyen pa bya tshul bri// de'ang bskal pa snyigs ma'i dus 'dir dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la lha srin sde brgyad spyi dang*/ khyad par srog bdag rgyal 'gong gis nyer 'tshe che bas/ de'i gnyen por gyur pa gu ru drag po'i bsgoms bzlas la brtson pa ni dgos pa shin tu che bar khums/ de la'ang lugs srol mang du mchis pa las/ 'dir mnga' bdag nyang gi lugs su gyur pa gu ru drag po dmar po me'i phreng ba can gyi bsnyen pa bya ba'i tshul la/ 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba thob pa'i gang zag gis tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus bzang por gnas khang phyag dar skyang nul byas te/ 'di'i sku rten bris 'bur gang rung bshams pa'i mdun du/ gtor ma dpal gtor dmar po rgyan ldan/ de'i g.yas su sman phud dang*/ g.yon du rak+ta dang*/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang*/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma/ bstan skyong gi gtor ma/ nye bar spyod pa rnams dang gtor bsngo gzhan dang 'brel na de la dgos pa'i gtor ma dang bcas pa lag len bzhin bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod la sogs pa mkho ba'i yo byad rnams nyer bsdogs bya/ dngos gzhi la rang gu ru drag por gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs sprin gtibs pa ltar dmigs la/ thog mar bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba btab/ sngon 'gro'i gtor mas bran la/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa nas brtsams te/ rol mo dang bcas te rtsa ba'i sngags brjod pas bgegs bskrad pa'i bar dang*/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'khod de skyabs su 'gro bar mos la/

na mo bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku zhes sogs kyi skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i bar phrin las kyi gzhung dregs pa zil gnon ltar nyams su blang ngo*// bsnyen pa dngos ni 'di'i rtsa sngags yi ge nyi shu pa gtso bor bzla/ mjug tu rtsa ba'i sngags la sham bur btags pa can gyi rgyun du ma chags tsam las mang po mi bzla zhing*/ gal te sde brgyad sogs kyis gnod pa'i ltas byung na dmigs pa bcas te brgya rtsa sogs bzla bar gsung*/ thun 'jog pa na phreng ba thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung ste/ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang sogs kyi gsol ba gdab/ nub dang po dang*/ rjes ma dang*/ dus bzang rnams su tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya zhing*/ dgongs thun gyi 'gor sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ mjug tu bar chad srung ba'i phyir gtor chung zhig la dmigs te/ ho bod khams skyong ba'i sogs nas/ ya hi gats+tsha zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan skyong gi gtor ma btang*/ de nas thun gyi mjug tu/ bdag mdun dus gcig tu bsgrub pa'i lugs yin pas rjes kyi mchod pa rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ i daṃ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe nas shab+da ma hā pū dza ho zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+ma kro dha sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐ rang byung pad+ma sogs kyis bstod/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs zhes sogs kyis 'dod pa'i don gyi gsol ba gdab pa nas/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyi bar thams cad gzhung bzhin bya'o// yang sngags grangs 'gro che ba'i ched sogs kyis de las sgrub thabs cung zad nyung bar 'dod na/ ye shes spyan 'dren gyi/ bdud dang mu stegs 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol/ oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+ma kro dha sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pa yan chad gzhung bzhin byas la/ de nas mtshan sngags de nyid sngon du 'gro ba'i oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/

shab+da'i bar gyi phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ ma hā pū dza sarba pañtsa āḥhūm̐ zhes pas nang gi mchod pa dang*/ oṃ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi zhes pas sman gyi mchod pa dang*/ oṃ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi zhes pas rak+ta'i mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma ni rtsa sngags kyi rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrat+na gu ru sogs btags pa'am/ gong gi mtshan sngags la ma hā ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ spro na/ mkhan chen bud+dha'i mtshan can gyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen thabs nas 'byung ba'i che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ sku 'jam dpal sogs nas mngon spyod kyi las 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar gyi 'dod gsol yang brjod do// de nas hūm̐ rang byung sogs sh+lau ka gcig po des bstod la/ thugs ka'i phyag rdor sogs kyis dmigs pa gsal btab ste bzlas pa la 'jug pa sogs man chad thams cad snga ma bzhin bya'o// yang sgrub thabs de las kyang nyung ba la dga' bas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang ba dang*/ de'i rjes su mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las snod ban+dha 'bar ba sogs nas/ gu h+ya ma hā pū dza hoḥzhes pa'i bar gyi byin rlabs rgyas pa ltar sngon du btang rjes/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste/ de yi sa la 'god par shog ces pa'i bar gyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge las 'byung ba ltar bya zhing*/ der mi gsal ba'i khyad par ni/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ zhes pa'i rjes su/ yi ge gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams dang phyogs bcu'i rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi lha la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pa tsam brjod/ sman rag phul ba'i rjes su/ gong ltar mtshan sngags la gtor ma'i sngags btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas bstod pa la 'jug

bzlas pa'i mjug tu/ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad lha srin sde brgyad kyi nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi ba dang*/ myur du pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa lta bu'i rang gang 'dod pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams brjod pas don grub bo// de lta bu'i tshul gyis sgo gsum 'jug pa rtse gcig tu bsgril te thun gsum mam bzhi'i rim pas bsnyen tshad rab 'bring gsum gang 'os gzhung ltar ram/ sgrub thabs bde gshegs 'dus par/ 'bum phrag drug gi grangs ni bzlas gyur na// nus pa u rgyan pad+ma nyid dang mnyam// zhes pa ltar 'bum phrag drug sogs gang 'grub bzlas pas/ gzhung nas ji skad bshad pa'i phan yon rnams 'byung ba ni nges par yang dag pa nyid do// bsnyen yig nyung ngu don 'dus 'di// bgyis pa'i dge bas 'jig rten gyi// dregs pa dbang 'dus stobs bcu pa'i// bstan la bya ba bgyid par shog /ces gu ru drag dmar gyi bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge nyung ngu don 'dus zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dge slong bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyis bskul ltar/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas 'phral du sbyar ba bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
